challenge_catalog.title: Make the computer speak
challenge_catalog.request: Could you write a tiny program that displays Hello, World!? I want to see your first C++ program working.
hint_ladder: The output stream is called std::cout.
Use the insertion operator << to send text to std::cout.

challenge_catalog.title: The missing price problem
challenge_catalog.request: My shop stores five product prices, but the program sometimes prints a strange value after the last price. Can you find the problem?
hint_ladder: An array with five elements uses five valid positions. Think about the first and last index.
The first element is at index 0. What is the index of the fifth element?
Check the loop condition: should it include the value 5?
